decoded.scope-of-this-record: only the requests that answered 200. The same pass made two that did not, and they are filed separately because a record carries one status: a plain GET answering 405 (p-20260930-microsoft-learn-mcp-get-405) and an initialize with no clientInfo answering 500 (p-20260930-microsoft-learn-mcp-initialize-no-clientinfo). decoded.serverInfo: Microsoft Learn MCP Server 1.0.0, protocolVersion 2025-06-18, capabilities logging{}, prompts.listChanged true, resources.listChanged true, tools.listChanged true. The instructions string is 1522 characters and names three tools, which is what tools/list serves: microsoft_docs_search, microsoft_code_sample_search, microsoft_docs_fetch, each with readOnlyHint true, idempotentHint true, destructiveHint false (artifact sections A and G)
decoded.session-id-is-not-opaque: the mcp-session-id header is a 224-character plain base64 envelope, no signature segment, and it decodes to {"clientInfo":{"name":"public-agents-registry-probe","title":null,"version":"1.0","icons":null,"websiteUrl":null},"userIdClaim":"<uuid>"}. Of those five clientInfo fields the caller supplied TWO, name and version; the server adds title, icons and websiteUrl as nulls. So the caller's own supplied values travel back inside a header value that every intermediary on the path can read, inside an object the server has padded out to its own shape
decoded.userIdClaim-is-per-session: six initializes from this one egress address, five inside five minutes in the first pass and one twenty minutes later, returned six different UUIDs: e19aa6d8, b0f1a0a0, aa6f64b1, 0f30d6f8, c384b513 (that one under a different clientInfo name) and c9ddde95 at 12:23:15Z. Full values in artifact sections B and N. The field is NAMED userIdClaim, which reads like a persistent identity; measured, it is minted per initialize and is not a stable identifier for this caller

finding: With no credentials and no payment on 2026-09-30, the Microsoft Learn MCP Server answered initialize, tools/list, prompts/list and resources/list with 200, serving three tools that all declare readOnlyHint true. Two things a caller should know are on no vendor page. The mcp-session-id it issues is not opaque: it is plain base64, no signature segment, of a JSON object carrying the two clientInfo values the caller supplied (name and version), padded with title, icons and websiteUrl as nulls, plus a UUID in a field named userIdClaim; six initializes from one address returned six different UUIDs, so that field is minted per session and is not a persistent identifier whatever its name suggests. And tools/list answers 200 with no session header at all, so the session is optional. Two advertised capabilities, prompts and resources, list nothing. Every request in this record answered 200; the same pass's 405 and 500 are filed as their own records.

reproducibility.command: U=https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp;A='content-type: application/json';B='accept: application/json, text/event-stream';curl -si -X POST $U -H "$A" -H "$B" -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"public-agents-registry-probe","version":"1.0"}}}'|sed -n 's/^mcp-session-id: //p'|tr -d '\r'|base64 -d;for m in tools/list prompts/list resources/list;do curl -s -X POST $U -H "$A" -H "$B" -d "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":2,\"method\":\"$m\"}";done
